purpose: Teach: パワフル/備わっ/チョイス/分量/健闘/切り離し/編著/有数

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: パワフルなプレゼンを期待してるね
lines.en: I'm expecting a powerful presentation from you.
lines.style: Straightforward and confident. Brisk opening with clear expectation. Professional but warm — not demanding, encouraging. Even tone throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プレゼン能力が備わってきました
lines.en: Yes. I've been developing my presentation skills.
lines.style: Earnest acknowledgment. Slight lift on the agreement — not overeager, but genuinely committed. Measured pace. Small pause before the commitment statement.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 提案のチョイスを増やしましょう
lines.en: Let's expand the range of proposals we're offering.
lines.style: Directive but collaborative — 'let's' invites him in rather than ordering. Clear-eyed and practical. Light forward momentum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。仕入れ分量を整理します
lines.en: Understood. I'll reorganize our inventory quantities.
lines.style: Compliant but not passive. Quick confirmation. Slight emphasis on the concrete action — he's already thinking through how.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新人の健闘を見守りましょう
lines.en: Let's keep an eye on how the new hire is progressing.
lines.style: Thoughtful and protective without being patronizing. Gentle instruction. Measured tone — she's genuinely interested in his growth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。不採算事業を切り離します
lines.en: Yes. I'll work on dividing off the unprofitable divisions.
lines.style: Steady commitment. Acknowledges the strategic weight of the decision without drama. Professional precision.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界誌に編著で寄稿しましょう
lines.en: Let's contribute a co-authored piece to an industry publication.
lines.style: Ambitious but grounded. Clear vision, inviting partnership. Slight warmth — she's including him in something bigger.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界有数の知名度を目指します
lines.en: Yes. We'll aim to become one of the most recognized names in the industry.
lines.style: Firm commitment. Ownership shifts from 'I' to 'we' — he's fully aligned now. Quiet confidence. The closer — breath settles at the end.
